ios.desc:
Xiaoweiba APP, a simple and handy AI assistant. Whether it’s for travel, work, study, or daily life, it’s your smart language companion in your pocket.  
Connect with the world, starting with clear conversations. Xiaoweiba APP is your lightweight, intelligent bridge for communication and life.  

【Core Features】  
● Text Translation: Input or paste text and instantly convert it into your target language, with real human voice and floating subtitles, making reading and browsing smooth and easy.  
● Quick Voice Translation: Speak and translate instantly, highly accurate recognition, making cross-language conversations effortless—you can travel the world speaking your native language.  
● Face-to-Face Translation: Supports real-time bilingual conversations; each person speaks their native language for smoother communication without needing an intermediate language.  
● Simultaneous Interpretation: Real-time translations for meetings and negotiations, seamless communication, uninterrupted listening.  
● Bilingual Calls: Real-time translations during voice and video calls, with dual subtitles, bridging distances across countries. No app download required for the other party—they join via a link. (Note: Works even better with a translation device.)  

【More than Translation, Smarter Organization】  
● Voice Notes: One-click recording of meetings, classes, and interviews, with real-time transcription retaining the original text.  
● AI Smart Summaries: Automatically extract the core content and generate Chinese summaries, helping you quickly understand what’s being discussed.  
● Mind Maps: Generate visual structures with one click, organize your ideas clearly, and share directly with your team.  

【Use Cases】  
● International business meetings · Academic lectures · Foreign affairs receptions · Overseas travel · Language learning  

Xiaoweiba makes every conversation easy and relaxed—explore the world, make friends, handle multilingual scenarios—it’s in your hand and ready anytime.  
More thoughtful features are continuously being updated, stay tuned.  

Download Xiaoweiba APP now and start a new experience of barrier-free communication.
